moodContent: Defines a character's mood level. Sadness causes issues.
karmaContent: Shows whether a character is good or evil.
HealthPointsContent: The character dies if it drops to 0.
CreativityContent: Defines how good a character is at art.
WealthContent: Shows how much money a character has.
CharacterTasksContent_1: You must complete these 3 tasks before the character runs out of turns. Completing only one of them is enough to unlock the next life.
Task1: Bake a birthday cake for Selma.
Task2: Hold a birthday party for Selma.
CharacterTasksContent_2: Each turn, you will be given 4 choices randomly picked from the choice-pool. Selecting one will move the life 1 turn forward. Try to pick the choices related to the tasks.
BoostersContent: There are 5 different boosters which can be used for extra help.
BoosterRefreshContent: Brings 4 different choices without wasting a turn.
BoosterSwapperContent: Allows you to pick 2 choices to refresh.
BoosterSkillBoosterContent: Boosts one of the skills randomly: Charisma, Intelligence, Creativity and Physique.
luna_choice_tutorial_text_1: Pick one of the 4 choices to play the game. Each choice advances the story by 1 turn. You must try to complete the tasks written above.
luna_powerup_tutorial_text_2: Use these power-ups to help you along the way. Check out the help page for details.
lifeWellDone: Well done! You completed all of the tasks, time to play the next story.
Luna_tutorial_1: Hey there, I'm Luna! Unicoville's ex-mayor.
Luna_tutorial_2: I must get ready for my farewell party. I must write a moving speech and find the perfect dress.
Luna_tutorial_3: After that boring mayorhood, I'm craving for some action! Maybe a new love in the horizon for me?
Luna_tutorial_4: So what do you say about helping me with the party and my love life?
Alyx_tutorial_2: I just received a call from a mysterious stranger regarding Tutankhamun's flute.
Alyx_tutorial_3: I always wanted to add that to my artifact collection! I must meet with the man and find the flute.
Violet_tutorial_1: I always wanted to add that to my artifact collection! I must meet with the man and find the flute.
Violet_tutorial_2: Even though I've tons of achievements, I haven't realized my dreams of becoming an interior designer.
Violet_tutorial_3: I must finish an interior design course and design some remarkable projects to fulfill my dreams.
Robert_tutorial_1: Hello there, Name is Robert. But you can call me Bob.
Robert_tutorial_2: I've fallen in love with a lovely woman named Linda. I must get married to her.
Robert_tutorial_3: I also want a big family with at least 3 children.
Valeria_tutorial_1: Greetings, I'm Valeria, a police officer.
Valeria_tutorial_2: I want to get into the Crime Investigation team as a detective.
Valeria_tutorial_3: I must also solve a crime case to fulfill my ambitions as a detective.
Mariam_tutorial_1: Hi, my name is Mariam. I have been drawing since I was 4.
Mariam_tutorial_2: I want to make a name for myself as a painter, but I need to work hard for that.
Mariam_tutorial_3: I must start in the streets, then win international recognition by winning a contest and finally get curated.
X43_tutorial_1: Greetings from the Cosmos, I'm X43. An Alien from the distant space.
X43_tutorial_2: My people sent me to prepare the Earth for our conquest.
X43_tutorial_3: I must blend in, find the human self-defense weapons and finally set up a signal beam.
Aadav_tutorial_1: Hey there! I'm Aadav, a rookie hacker who wants to make a name for himself.
Aadav_tutorial_2: I must gather hacking tools and form up a hacker team.
Aadav_tutorial_3: My ultimate goal is to hack the world's most secure firewall, ULTRON!
Jackie_tutorial_1: Well met. I'm Jackie, a cursed sorcerer with magical powers.
Jackie_tutorial_2: My only friends in this life are the wizards in the Wizards Club. But something terrible has happened!
Jackie_tutorial_3: I must find the ones who killed my friends and took their revenge! I must especially get their leader!
Henry_tutorial_1: Sup? I'm Henry and I'm just starting college!
Henry_tutorial_2: I want to have lots of friends and become the most popular kid around the campus.
Henry_tutorial_3: My ultimate ambition is to have a huge party with lots of students.
